//go:build integration

package order_test

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	pb "example.com/acme/workspace/api/gen/go/order/v1"
	"example.com/acme/workspace/infrastructure/bootstrap"
	"example.com/acme/workspace/services/order"
)

func TestGeneratedAPIBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	token := strings.Repeat("x", 32)
	application, servers, err := bootstrap.New(t.Context(), bootstrap.Config{Address: "127.0.0.1:0", GRPCAddress: "127.0.0.1:0", Token: token}, order.Register)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, stop := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- application.Run(ctx) }()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		stop()
		select {
		case err := <-done:
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
			t.Error("shutdown timeout")
		}
	})
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for servers.GRPC.URL() == nil {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("listener timeout")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
	conn, err := grpc.NewClient(servers.GRPC.URL().Host, grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	client := pb.NewOrderServiceClient(conn)
	rpcctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if _, err := client.CreateOrder(rpcctx, &pb.CreateOrderRequest{}); status.Code(err) != codes.Unauthenticated {
		t.Fatalf("unauthenticated: %v", err)
	}
	rpcctx = metadata.AppendToOutgoingContext(rpcctx, "authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	if _, err := client.CreateOrder(rpcctx, &pb.CreateOrderRequest{}); status.Code(err) != codes.Unimplemented {
		t.Fatalf("create: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := client.GetOrder(rpcctx, &pb.GetOrderRequest{OrderId: "42"}); status.Code(err) != codes.Unimplemented {
		t.Fatalf("get: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := client.Ping(rpcctx, &pb.PingRequest{}); status.Code(err) != codes.Unimplemented {
		t.Fatalf("gRPC-only API: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := client.Inspect(rpcctx, &pb.InspectRequest{}); status.Code(err) != codes.Unimplemented {
		t.Fatalf("scaffolded API: %v", err)
	}
}
